insights.one_liner: US-headquartered pharma consulting and services firm with a Leiden office that is an IND recognised sponsor and lists an English-language senior life sciences role.

culture.text: Helps pharmaceutical companies through every stage of a drug's lifecycle, working as a consulting partner; Treximo merged into it in 2021.
Staff often studied chemistry, biology, biotechnology or computer science, working in research, quality assurance and consulting.
Headquartered in Western Springs, Illinois, with its Dutch role based in Leiden.
